merge_rules.daily: Use Project daily_ohlcv.csv through 2026-09-08; append/replace public daily_delta.csv rows with date > 2026-09-08 by (symbol,date).
merge_rules.weekly: Use Project weekly baseline before week 2026-09-05/2026-09-11; replace all rows from week 2026-09-05/2026-09-11 onward with public weekly_replace.csv by (symbol,week).
merge_rules.index_daily: Use Project index_daily_ohlcv.csv through 2026-09-08; append/replace public index_daily_delta.csv rows with date > 2026-09-08 by (symbol,date).

routing.current_analysis: Read manifest.json first. If fresh, merge public delta with Project frozen baseline using merge_rules, then run Data/Freshness Gate before analysis.
routing.market_scan: Use market_scan.csv + sector_scan.csv for screening overlays, then verify Wyckoff price-volume evidence on merged daily/weekly sequences.
routing.historical_holdout: ANALYSIS_CUTOFF is absolute. Never use rows after cutoff.
routing.api_contract: NONE. These are public read-only static files over HTTPS, not an assumed API.

method_safety: Provisional bars may describe forming behavior but cannot alone CONFIRM a major Event/Phase or completed weekly breakout/breakdown.
Return/MA/peer metrics are Project overlays; they cannot create or upgrade Wyckoff Event/Phase labels.
Wave-to-wave RS must still be evaluated from corresponding price swings after merge.
Same-cutoff OHLCV conflict => DATA CONFLICT; block Locked Analysis until reconciled.
